The Verses of the Elder Uttarapāla:
“Truly I am wise, being one who contemplates the goal with sufficient skill;”
The five strands of sensual pleasure in the world,
through delusion, have cast me down;
leaping into the domain of Māra.
Firmly struck by the arrow of disease,
I was able to escape from the snare of the King of Death.
All sensual desires have been abandoned by me;
all states of existence have been shattered;
the wandering through births is exhausted.
“There is now no further becoming,” said the elder Uttara-pāla. … [The elder] Uttara-pāla.
